summary: Iteration 6 — backend-only verification of DropKit referral lifecycle, Klaviyo fire-and-forget no-op, and the 3 new admin broadcast endpoints. 13/14 pytest cases PASS; 1 SKIPPED honestly because today is May 12, 2026 and routes_public.create_substitution enforces day<=10 (substitution window closed — not a defect). Klaviyo PLACEHOLDER no-op confirmed: every waitlist/substitution/gift/webhook path returns 200 with zero Klaviyo errors in backend logs. All 12 lifecycle helpers in klaviyo_service.py route through `_post` which short-circuits to None when KLAVIYO_API_KEY starts with PLACEHOLDER.

critical.issue: Same Cloudflare/ingress 404 as iteration_5 — preview public URL still returns 404 'page not found' for every /api/* path. Backend healthy on localhost:8001. Not a code defect; ingress routing issue. Tests run against http://localhost:8001 via BACKEND_TEST_URL.

minor.issue: queued count includes waitlist docs even when the user has unsubscribed elsewhere — no marketingConsent check before firing. Acceptable for MVP (Klaviyo profile-level suppression handles it) but worth noting.
When candidate ObjectIds are stored as strings in cycle.candidateProjectIds, the `isinstance(c, ObjectId) or ObjectId.is_valid(c)` guard correctly converts them; verified.

Hard-coded day>10 close window means the endpoint cannot be exercised end-to-end after the 10th of any month. Consider injecting a clock for tests, or expose an admin override flag, so this test path doesn't perma-skip in CI.

action_items: (Platform) Restore the public preview ingress so https://mvp-planner-6.preview.emergentagent.com/api/* forwards to backend:8001 — the frontend cannot reach the backend in the preview environment.
(Optional/dev-quality) Make the substitution day<=10 cutoff injectable so this branch is testable year-round (currently auto-skips after the 10th).
(Optional) routes_admin.broadcast_launch_announcement could skip waitlist rows missing marketingConsent once Klaviyo profile sync is wired.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_public.join_waitlist correctly stamps referredVia ONLY inside the $setOnInsert block — resubmits with a different ref_src do not overwrite. Verified.

Priority unlock (`if wl_refs == 3 and not ref_doc.get('priorityNotified')`) uses strict equality + idempotency flag, so the priority_unlocked event + DB flag fire exactly once. Verified at wlRefs=1,2,3,4.
freeMonthEarned in /waitlist/{code}/status correctly requires paidReferrals>=5 AND selfActive (cross-collection check against db.users.subscriptionStatus). Verified by toggling both axes.
klaviyo_service.fire() schedules via loop.create_task with add_done_callback to log exceptions — correct fire-and-forget pattern; the calling endpoint never blocks or 500s on Klaviyo failure.

klaviyo_service._post short-circuits to None when key starts with PLACEHOLDER — single debug log, no HTTP call. Confirmed by zero Klaviyo errors in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log across a full test run.

routes_admin.broadcast_vote_opened: queued count is computed by iterating users with subscriptionStatus='active' inside the same coroutine — accurate snapshot. The cycle 404 / 400 / bad ObjectId paths are all correctly distinguished. Verified.
routes_admin.broadcast_vote_results: explicit `if not cycle.get('winnerId')` → 400. Verified — returns 400 before winner set, 200 after.

routes_webhooks.orders/paid (subscription branch): existing_user is read BEFORE the upsert and welcome only fires when `was_active` was False — correct first-activation-only semantics. Verified by sending two webhooks for the same customer; second one returns 200 with no state regression and no Klaviyo error.
routes_webhooks.gifts: gift_purchased + gift_code_issued both fire on the same orders/paid gift branch — correct dual notification (buyer + recipient).
Shopify Customer OAuth /auth/shopify/login still returns 503 under placeholder creds. Verified.
models.WaitlistJoin.ref_src has max_length=16 — sufficient for tw/bsky/wa/sms/email/native; 422 enforcement intact via Pydantic.

success_rate.backend: 100% of executed tests (13/13 passed; 1 honest skip due to month-day business rule)

seed_data_creation: Throw-away rows prefixed TEST_iter6_ in waitlist/users/projects/vote_cycles/gifts/substitutions (tagged _iter6:true where the doc has no slug/email key). Session fixture teardown removes everything. Verified zero leftovers via cleanup queries. The fixture also resets dev user subscriptionStatus to inactive on teardown so subsequent iterations start clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: BACKEND_TEST_URL=http://localhost:8001 MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=dropkit pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test_iter6.py -v --tb=short. The dev session uses auth.create_access_token because the login cookie has Secure=true. The substitution test auto-skips if today's day > 10 — to exercise it, either run before the 10th of any month or temporarily relax the guard. If the public preview ingress is restored, drop BACKEND_TEST_URL and re-run.
rca_of_the_issue: No new bugs found. Pre-existing ingress 404 on preview URL persists from iteration_5 and is platform-side, not backend code. Substitution test skip is due to business-rule date guard, not a defect. Klaviyo no-op verified end-to-end: zero exceptions, zero error logs, every dependent endpoint returns its happy-path 200/4xx as spec'd.
